Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
1.

Heard Sri Satyendra Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri K.K. Rai, learned Aga for
the State.

2. This application under Section 528 of the B.N.S.S. has been filed by the applicant to quash the
impugned order dated 02.05.2025 passed by the Judicial Magistrate-II, Saidpur, Ghazipur issuing
non-bailable warrants against the applicant in Criminal Case No. 741 of 2022 (State vs. Rajkumar
and other), arising out of Case Crime No. 97 of 2021, under Sections 406, 420, 504 and 506 Ipc,
Police Station Bhudkuda, District Ghazipur.
3.

Earlier the applicant has approached this Court while filing the Application U/S 482 No. 30984 of 2022 (Chandrakala and 3 others vs. State of U.P. and another), in which on 10.1.2023, the following order has been passed:-
"1.

sentences.text: Submission is, a pure civil dispute has been given the colour of criminal prosecution.
In any case, the main allegation is against one Raj Kumar to whom the money had been paid in his bank account, as specified in the F.I.R.
The Present applicants are the wife of the said Raj Kumar and persons known to him, who have been falsely implicated.
3. On the other hand, learned A.G.A. and the learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 would submit, at present, no inference of fact may be drawn.
Specific allegations have been leveled against all the applicants.
There is no material to quash the present prosecution.

4. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record inasmuch as specific allegations of cheating exist by alluring the informant's wife to part with substantial amount of money to secure a job for his son, no case is made out to quash the criminal prosecution.
The exact role of the applicants may remain a matter to be considered upon evidence being led at the trial and/or at the appropriate stage.
In the present case, the allegation is that the applicant no. 1 befriended the wife of the informant and that led to the occurrence.
5. Leaving all courses open to the applicants to apply for bail and discharge at the appropriate stage, no interference is warranted, at present.

It is further made clear,
all other remedies that may be sought by the applicants, may be dealt with on own merit without being prejudiced by any observation made in this order.
6.
Accordingly, the present applicant is dismissed."
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that non-bailable warrants have been issued on 02.05.2025.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that due to certain circumstances beyond the control and the comprehension of the applicant, he could not join the proceedings and present himself.

He just submits that breathing time be accorded to the applicant to file a recall application for recalling of the non-bailable warrants and till recall application is decided, protection be accorded to the applicant.
5. Learned AGA has no objection to the same.

6. Considering the submissions so made across bar, the application stands disposed of directing the applicant to file a recall application for recalling of the non-bailable warrants by 20.6.2025 and on the said motion, subject to the statutory compliance which is to be made by the applicant as per the statute, the court below shall decide the recall application with most expedition strictly in accordance with law without granting unnecessary adjournment subject to legal impediment, if any.
